Sissirat's Super Sissy Stick of Stench
Client type:  1H Staff
Class palette:  Mage
Quality:  Mythic (rainbow)

Sissirat's Super Sissy Stick of Stench is a named mythic item from the client file items/pal/1HStaffPAL.gc (MythicPreBuiltBoss001).

This is the base name. Rolled mythics can also append a suffix from Mythic Suffixes. Those endings change the last part of the name and add the bonus listed on that page. This page does not invent extra roll combinations.

The template sets SoulBound = true.

Fixed mods on this template (client LabelType = NONE, always on the item):

  • +Poison
  • +Poison
  • Max mana
  • INT
  • Defense
